name: Methyl glucoside propoxylate
description: Methyl glucoside propoxylate (CAS 61849-72-7 ) is a propoxylated sugar-based polyol used as a functional ingredient in personal care and industrial formulations. It acts as a humectant, rheology modifier, and carrier across a range of finished product types. In personal care formulations, it conditions skin by retaining moisture and improving the sensory profile of creams, lotions, and cleansers. Formulators incorporate it as a co-solvent or carrier to improve the dispersion of active ingredients. Its polyol structure supports rheology modification in gel-based and emulsion systems where viscosity control is a formulation requirement. This makes it highly effective in topical pharmaceutical and cosmetic systems. In polymer and resin applications, it functions as a reactive polyol building block for polyurethane systems where bio-derived content is a specification target. This versatility allows for its use in diverse industrial sectors. Methyl glucoside propoxylate is typically supplied as a viscous liquid. Technical and cosmetic-grade material are the most commonly available specifications, with grade selection driven by end-use regulatory requirements. Personal care applications generally require higher purity documentation than industrial uses.
